purpose: Versioned source register for research baselines in cloth simulation, robotic garment manipulation, textile sorting and sewing. This manifest does not declare any dataset ingested or authorize redistribution.

sources.name: RGBench Cloth Sim-to-Real v1
known_limitations: two released garments have non-manifold meshes and are excluded from paper published baselines
small real garment evaluation set
not a robotic sewing benchmark
sources.intended_use: reproduce published bidirectional point-cloud simulation-to-reality metrics, then extend with task-weighted physical fidelity
sources.redistribution_action: verify exact file license and attribution; CC-BY-4.0 is stated on the current dataset card

sources.name: Near Infrared Spectra of Origin-defined and Real-world Textiles
known_limitations: specimen-level dataset, not a complete industrial incoming-stream sample
microscopy subset is large and should be an explicit opt-in download
catalog does not by itself establish permission to redistribute all files
sources.intended_use: fibre/blend classification, instrument-transfer and open-set validation with specimen-grouped splits
sources.redistribution_action: inspect repository README and file-level terms before copying or publishing

sources.name: TexSortML

public_scope.split_protocol: garment-level stratified five-fold; all three presentation frames for a garment stay in one fold

known_limitations: 751 garments came from collection containers and were already facility-pre-sorted
one facility sample, not a random sample of all incoming waste
labels cover visual garment category and deformation, not fibre composition
small and class-imbalanced dataset
sources.intended_use: visual garment-family and presentation-state robustness only
sources.redistribution_action: verify Zenodo record license and attribution

sources.name: ClothDojo: Learned Data Generation and Benchmarking for Bimanual Garment Flattening and Folding

reported_claims.scope: bimanual garment flattening and folding across hundreds of garments
reported_claims.method: learned trajectory generation with canonical NOCS cues, then randomized appearance rendering for RGB policy training

known_limitations: preprint, not an independent Luminous replication
unseen-garment generalization remains an open challenge
simulated rollout success is not physical task success
sources.intended_use: method comparator for generated training data after independent cloth model validation
sources.redistribution_action: do not assume dataset or implementation is publicly licensed from the preprint alone

sources.name: ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition
known_limitations: in-air unfolding grasp selection only
not sewing or full production
competition score can conceal coverage trade-offs
sources.intended_use: reproduce grasp selection and report success/coverage separately

sources.name: A Robotic sewing system for flexible fabric manipulation using computer vision, learning-based grasping and force control
sources.license_status: open_access_paper; no reusable benchmark dataset identified

reported_scope.control: vision seam tracking plus force-regulated tension

known_limitations: limited user intervention remains
one robot setup and task family
small grasp-image evaluation described in the paper
not a general autonomous factory benchmark
sources.intended_use: matched seam tracking and physical construction comparator
sources.redistribution_action: cite the paper; do not assume supplementary experiment data is openly redistributable

split_policy: never split repeated spectra or frames from the same physical specimen/garment across train and held-out evaluation
hold out complete garment identities and, where available, material families and source lots
keep calibration specimens separate from scored validation specimens
keep simulator-generated observations distinct from physical observations
report source, instrument, material, garment and task strata rather than only one pooled mean
cross_dataset_rule: TexSortML visual garment-family labels are not fibre-composition labels. NIR-SORT composition observations are not garment-category labels. Fusion is permitted only with matched item identity, independent measurement provenance and explicit missing/unknown states.
claim_ceiling: This source register is a research intake manifest. It does not prove that any dataset has been downloaded, parsed, reproduced, licensed for redistribution, or evaluated by Luminous Dynamics.
